entries.title: India online travel agency non-compete
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd is restricted from developing, licensing, or providing travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India during the contract term and for 12 months thereafter.
entries.quote: In consideration of the access provided to the Client's business processes and supplier arrangements, the Service Provider agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (l2) months after its expiry or termination, it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.

relatedClauses.quote: Nothing in Clause 6.1 shall restrict the Service Provider from providing services to hotels, airlines or other businesses that are not online travel agencies, or from providing services unrelated to travel-booking software.

entries.notes: The OCR scan contains a minor typo 'twelve (l2) months' which is preserved in the quote.

entries.title: Mutual staff non-solicitation
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd agreed to a mutual non-solicitation restriction covering each other's employees during the term and for 6 months after.
entries.quote: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other during the term and six months thereafter.
entries.notes: This restriction is mutual, covers employees generally, and has a 6-month post-termination survival tail.
